tool_arguments.prompt:
Create NEW hand-painted pose drawings from scratch, using the attached adopted neutral solely as exact character identity and drawing-style reference. This is a production sprite image, not a character redesign. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Make a TALL PORTRAIT canvas (1024x1536 or larger native portrait) with EXACTLY THREE separate complete drawings in ONE VERTICAL COLUMN, top/middle/bottom in the order below; each drawing large, centered in its own equally sized band, with generous transparent gutter and padding. No panel boxes, letters, labels, floor, shadow, colored backdrop, effect/speed lines, sparkles, water or props. Preserve the reference warm brown contour, same thin-to-medium edge, simple dot eyes, soft watercolor/paper texture contained entirely within painted silhouette, color blocks, head/body proportions and simplification. Do not become realistic, do not add costume or human limbs. Dark compact bird with three simple curly crest lobes, yellow bill and round yellow knob, cream belly, two gray feet and fan-shaped dark tail. The three poses must have the same anatomical size and stationary support/body center; do not fit them independently or enlarge quieter poses. Show every appendage without clipping or overlap with other rows.
1. cheer: Friendly celebration with both existing wings/flippers spread a little, ordinary feet remain grounded.
2. species_a: A tiny forward nod, with the existing crest and large bill moving as attached parts of the head.
3. species_b: The head starts returning toward its original angle, preserving bill profile, folded wing, tail and two feet.
